description: Xilonimeh is a fast desktop and web anime tracker: your list, your progress, synced everywhere.
heroText: Xilonimeh keeps your watch list, progress and ratings in one fast app, synced between your desktop and the web.
appTitle: A tracker that feels like a real product.
featuresTitle: Made for the way you actually watch.
feature1Text: Add any anime in seconds from a catalog of thousands, set its status and track every episode.
feature2Text: Sign in once and the same list lives on your desktop and in the browser.
feature3Text: English, Persian, Russian, Chinese and Japanese, with full right-to-left support.
feature4Text: Show your friends what you’re watching, straight from the player.
feature5Text: Built with Tauri: a native window that starts fast and barely touches your RAM.
downloadText: Windows 10 and 11. Free, source available, and it updates itself.
blogText: Xilonimeh updates, fresh anime recommendations and what changed in each version.
post1Title: Alpha 0.36: a new look, a lighter self-updating app
post1Text: The desktop app moved from Electron to Tauri. The installer dropped to about 3 MB and new versions now install themselves.
post2Text: Create an account to keep the same list on your PC and in the web app.
post3Text: Each season we’ll share the new shows worth adding to your list.
loginText: Sign in to keep your list in sync between the desktop app and the web.
authOr: or
signupText: Your list is saved to your account and follows you to every device.
signupSwitch: Already have an account? Sign in
